Everyone needs that moment in their life where they buy into the hype and get massively disappointed. It happened with me and Donkey Kong Country*. And occasionally still happens to me as recent as Thief 2014. But the lesson here is massive and worth learning the hard way.

Never pre-order.

Might have been necessary in the past with sudden unexpected shortages of physical goods, but gaming these days aren't constrained by that anymore. There's no good reason to do it, you don't have to be first, you can let honest reviewers do their thing and play one of the other thousands of great games that are already out for the week before you decide you really want a new game. The creatures in the game are also getting boring, after a while you start seeing the same types with small differences such as their size or placement of their eyes. I have yet to see anything that resembled the big dinosaurs in the trailer. Then there is the whole thing with the annoying voice overs, 75 percent and everything is low, getting real tired of that shit. That's just a small part of it, I want to give the developers a chance and wait a month or so before considering moving on. Lets see how the updates pan out (if there are any).
